purpose: determine whether STAR50 and CSI1000 contain enough ordinary-state, cross-index-isolated first-tail events to justify a later model-free cross-index residual precursor-existence study; this census does not fit or evaluate a predictor

event_definition.sigma_pre: sqrt(trailing 30-minute mean squared return), shifted one minute so the current return is excluded
event_definition.first_tail: current tail_event and no tail_event in the prior 30 minutes within the same half-session
event_definition.reason: e-2 must be after the first 30 half-session minutes; no e-1 or event-minute state is used for precursor support classification

cross_index_event_subtype.peer_tail_nearby: peer index has any frozen V1 tail_event in the same half-session within event minute e +/- 2 minutes
cross_index_event_subtype.isolated_first_tail: no peer tail_event in e +/- 2 minutes
cross_index_event_subtype.note: this subtype is an ex-post census label only and may never be used as an input feature

historical_state_support.rv480: trailing 480-minute mean squared return with minimum 456 finite observations, same frozen state definition used by v3.5
historical_state_support.standardization: within-reference exact-group population standard deviation with 1e-8 floor
historical_state_support.support_limit: 99th percentile of each reference row's leave-one-out 100th-neighbor distance

historical_upper_state_rank.marginal_percentiles: midrank percentile of each e-2 log_sigma_pre and log_rv480 against its own index 2022-2023 exact half-session/minute reference
historical_upper_state_rank.ordinary_common_state: both target and peer are historically supported at e-2 and joint_upper_state_rank <= 0.80
historical_upper_state_rank.reason: ordinary means neither index is already in the historical upper 20% of either frozen volatility-state coordinate; low-volatility states remain ordinary only if they are inside the historical support domain

outputs: raw frozen first-tail counts by symbol/year
event table containing only event identity, e-2 past-state/support descriptors and ex-post peer-tail subtype
counts by symbol/year/joint upper-state bin among both-supported events
same outputs split by morning/afternoon and fixed event-minute bands 33-60,61-90,91-120

downstream_admission_rule.model_free_cross_index_residual_precurso: ordinary-common-state isolated first-tail count >= 10 separately in 2024 and 2025 for that target
downstream_admission_rule.if_rule_passes: a new research family may preregister one results-blind cross-index residual precursor score and test event-vs-matched-control existence only; no gate, no threshold scan
downstream_admission_rule.if_rule_fails: do not fit a sparse-event predictor for that target on consumed 2024-2025 history; wait for additional genuinely new-period support or change the scientific question rather than lowering the count rule

do_not: use V3.2/V3.3/V3.4 morphology score or try to rescue that stopped route
fit a classifier, regression, Hawkes model or threshold gate
choose a state bin after seeing event counts
use e-1 or event-minute state as precursor support
treat cross-index peer-tail subtype as a causal input
evaluate returns, PnL, trading, position sizing or production
